name: avatar-group
title: Avatar Group
description: Overlapping avatars that spring apart on hover, lift with a name label, and fan extra people out of a counting +N chip.

useCases: Showing who is on a project, in a document, or in a call, with names on hover and focus and a +N chip for the rest.
limitations: Initials or local images only; there is no remote image loading policy. Sizes are sm, md, and lg (32, 40, and 48 pixels). The fanned-out row sits below the group in a single line, so very long overflow lists should use a smaller max or a separate list.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Pass Avatar elements with a name as children, and give the group an aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating open in onOpenChange. Reduced motion keeps the spread and labels but makes every change instant and shows the count without counting.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/avatar-group.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
